challenge_list_basis: Four resources specified in the team's Step 11 brief. The challenge summary was discoverable, but its live resources tab could not be retrieved during this review.

sources.name: LROC QuickMap
sources.organization: LROC Science Operations Center / Arizona State University; QuickMap platform
sources.purpose: Explore LROC optical surface imagery and locate candidate image products.
sources.use_in_lunascend: External visual comparison resource. No QuickMap imagery, tiles or measurements are imported.
sources.coordinate_system: Product and layer dependent; no external image registration is asserted.
sources.usage_conditions: PDS-delivered LROC products and non-PDS website imagery have different terms. No imagery is redistributed here; review the specific product before reuse.
sources.attribution: LROC resource: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University. No agency or provider endorsement.
sources.offline: Resource notes available locally; the external map requires internet.
sources.limitations: The supplied URL redirected to quickmap.lroc.im-ldi.com during review. Selected-site comparison is manual; no coordinate deep-link API or imagery alignment is claimed.

sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
sources.organization: NASA SSERVI / JPL Solar System Treks
sources.purpose: Explore lunar maps, layer metadata and documented WMTS services.
sources.use_in_lunascend: External map and service-documentation links. No Moon Trek basemap or texture is installed.
sources.coordinate_system: Layer-specific equirectangular or polar tile matrix sets; no reprojection or registration is assumed.
sources.usage_conditions: Review each layer's metadata, attribution and usage conditions before integration. Portal access does not certify a layer's registration or confer blanket rights.
sources.attribution: NASA SSERVI / JPL Solar System Treks; individual layers retain their originating credits.
sources.offline: Resource notes available locally; external portal and WMTS documentation require internet.
sources.limitations: WMTS documentation was reviewed. A complete product, capabilities, rights and frame-alignment chain was not verified; no external layer is requested by the application.

sources.name: JPL Horizons
sources.organization: NASA / JPL Solar System Dynamics Group
sources.purpose: Reference ephemerides for finite cross-implementation checks of Sun/Earth angles.
sources.use_in_lunascend: Saved request/response records and executed Step 3 residuals. Live app calculations use local SPICE, not Horizons requests.
sources.version: Saved acquisition 2026-10-31; Horizons headers identify DE441
sources.coordinate_system: Horizons MEAN_ME (high precision), east-positive longitude, 1737.4 km sphere; geometric ICRF vectors and apparent AIRLESS AZ/EL references.
quantities: Geometric NONE and diagnostic apparent CN+S comparisons
sources.original_resolution: Three specified UTC epochs; not imagery or a terrain raster.
sources.usage_conditions: Credit NASA/JPL SSD. Saved references are reused offline. Any future acquisition must follow the official API fair-use guidance; this milestone adds no live query service.
sources.attribution: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics, Horizons System.
sources.offline: Saved references and displayed validation summary are bundled locally; live Horizons access is optional.
sources.limitations: Independent service/implementation comparison with shared JPL model heritage; not independent observational truth, global accuracy, terrain validation or mission certification.

sources.name: Canadian Space Agency Moon Exploration
sources.organization: Canadian Space Agency / Government of Canada
sources.purpose: Educational context on Canadian lunar exploration, Artemis, Gateway robotics and surface operations.
sources.use_in_lunascend: Background reading on Canadarm3, Gateway and lunar surface infrastructure. This motivates planning constraints; CSA supplies no numerical input to this application.
sources.coordinate_system: Not applicable: educational context, not geospatial data.
sources.usage_conditions: Educational summaries credit CSA. Third-party material and official logos have separate restrictions; no CSA logo, image or other media is reproduced.
sources.attribution: Credit: Canadian Space Agency. No association with or endorsement by CSA is implied.
sources.offline: The short attributed context is local; linked CSA pages require internet.
sources.limitations: Educational reference only; no CSA ephemeris, elevation, hardware specification or endorsement claim.

sources.name: JPL NAIF SPICE
sources.organization: NASA / JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
sources.purpose: Local Sun/Earth ephemeris geometry and exact lunar frame rotations.
sources.use_in_lunascend: The scientific backend uses pinned kernels and SpiceyPy. The isolated terrain frame bridge reconciles DE440/ME421 geometry and DE421 terrain.
sources.usage_conditions: Follow NAIF's SPICE rules and preserve kernel-producer attribution. Restore toolkit and unmodified kernels from the documented official sources; binaries remain outside Git.
sources.attribution: NASA/JPL NAIF SPICE and the teams supplying the pinned kernels.
sources.offline: Scientific calculations run locally after restoring the optional environment and pinned kernels.
sources.limitations: Geometric center directions, correction NONE and explicit heights. Reference-compared status applies only to matching saved cases/software/kernel identity.

sources.name: NASA LOLA / PGDA Site01
sources.organization: NASA Goddard PGDA / LRO LOLA team
sources.purpose: Finite surface elevation, terrain horizons and a georeferenced local display mesh.
sources.use_in_lunascend: Original DEM heights feed terrain/visibility calculations and the decimated 3D/polar viewer. Optical imagery is a separate product and is not installed.
sources.usage_conditions: Acknowledge the LOLA/PGDA producers and the manifest's Barker et al. citation. Preserve product metadata and attribution; no new raw-data redistribution in this milestone.
sources.attribution: NASA/GSFC/LRO LOLA; Barker et al. (2021), as recorded in the pinned manifest.
sources.offline: Local terrain works after the pinned DEM and frame kernels are restored; metadata stays available if data are absent.
sources.limitations: Only finite Site01 coverage. Nodata stays unknown, source spacing is not accuracy, uncertainty layers are not propagated, and display exaggeration/lighting do not alter science.
